value.locator: 5.4.1 Table4 Throughput of Native Arithmetic Instructions; Compute Capability9.0 column,32-bit or64-bit floating-point add/multiply/multiply-add
value.claim: Native FP32 multiply-add produces 128 results per clock per SM; this is instruction throughput, not merely legal operand types.

value.locator: 9.7.3.6 #floating-point-instructions-fma, fma.rnd.f32 / fma.rnd.f64 signatures, semantics and Notes
value.claim: Scalar FMA addend and destination use FP32; result rounds to that precision. Internal fused intermediate is not claimed to be a fixed-width accumulator.

value.locator: Table3 printed39–40: exact SKU SM count, FP32/FP64 non-Tensor Boost domain and peak rows; Table4 p41 CC9.0
value.claim: 132 SM * 128 FMA results/(SM cycle) * 1980e6 cycles/s * 2 FLOPs/FMA / 1e12 = 66.90816 TFLOPS; source rounded to 66.9

value.locator: 5.4.1 Table4 Throughput of Native Arithmetic Instructions; Compute Capability9.0 column,32-bit or64-bit floating-point add/multiply/multiply-add
value.claim: Native FP64 multiply-add produces 64 results per clock per SM; this is instruction throughput, not merely legal operand types.

value.locator: 9.7.3.6 #floating-point-instructions-fma, fma.rnd.f32 / fma.rnd.f64 signatures, semantics and Notes
value.claim: Scalar FMA addend and destination use FP64; result rounds to that precision. Internal fused intermediate is not claimed to be a fixed-width accumulator.

value.locator: Table3 printed39–40: exact SKU SM count, FP32/FP64 non-Tensor Boost domain and peak rows; Table4 p41 CC9.0
value.claim: 132 SM * 64 FMA results/(SM cycle) * 1980e6 cycles/s * 2 FLOPs/FMA / 1e12 = 33.45408 TFLOPS; source rounded to 33.5
